pages.title: Transitioning into Spots
pages.desc: 1 catches at FT line extended, 2 and 3 race to the corners, 4 inbounds and trails, 5 races to the rim.

track.title: Motion Offense: Entry & Initial Action

pages.title: Initiating Offense: 1 & 4 Pick and Pop
pages.desc: The offense starts when 4 catches the ball. Screen and rescreen, 5 slides opposite, 2 and 3 spot up.

track.title: Motion Offense: Entry & Initial Action

pages.title: Violent Cuts: Butt Screen, Sprint Screen
pages.desc: 4 hits the sprinting wing, 3 SPRINTS around the butt screen, 4 SPRINTS into his screen.

track.title: Motion Offense: Entry & Initial Action

pages.title: Scoring Reads
pages.desc: Rim-cutting wing, popping 1, or short roll face up. 1 pops behind the screen and never sets his feet.

track.title: Motion Offense: Entry & Initial Action

pages.title: Pick, Roll, Replace
pages.desc: 1 must get middle, 3 replaces early, 4 rolls correctly. 1 can play with his food before he eats.

track.title: Motion Offense: When the Initial Action Breaks Down

pages.title: Breakdown Rules
pages.desc: Don't try to regain the pattern. Pass and screen away, don't over dribble, don't pass and stand.

track.title: Motion Offense: When the Initial Action Breaks Down

pages.title: Staggered Away Screens
pages.desc: Stagger whenever possible. On post hits, the passer and the next closest teammate stagger away, Davidson Wildcats style.

track.title: Motion Offense: When the Initial Action Breaks Down

pages.title: Back Screen Our 4 into the Post
pages.desc: Look for chances to back screen the 4 into the post.

track.title: Motion Offense: When the Initial Action Breaks Down

pages.title: Pressure, DHOs and the Glass
pages.desc: When you're pressured, seek a DHO. On shots, 3, 4 and 5 crash while 1 and 2 get back.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Rules & Positioning

pages.title: The 5 Man-to-Man Rules
pages.desc: No middle penetration, no ball reversals, no help one pass away, no face cuts, move when the ball moves.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Rules & Positioning

pages.title: Defense Dictionary
pages.desc: On-ball, deny, help, ball-you-man, split line, High-I, Low-I, stunt, jump to the ball, banana closeout.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Rules & Positioning

pages.title: On-Ball, Deny and Help Defense
pages.desc: Contain and overplay the middle, one hand and foot in the lane when one pass away, ball-you-man when two away.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Rules & Positioning

pages.title: Positions by Ball Location: Top, Wing, Corner
pages.desc: Get it out of the top, never let it reverse, and keep two help defenders on the split line.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Rules & Positioning

pages.title: Top to Wing Pass: Allow or Deny?
pages.desc: We allow the pass to commit the ball to one side. Know when denying it disrupts their offense.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Dribble Penetration & Rotations

pages.title: Help Always Comes from the Weak Side
pages.desc: High-I and Low-I on the split line. The lowest weak-side defender steps across, and one pass away only stunts.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Dribble Penetration & Rotations

pages.title: Top of the Key Drive & Wing Baseline Drive
pages.desc: Low-I meets the driver outside the paint, High-I rotates down, the top defender drops to intercept.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Dribble Penetration & Rotations

pages.title: Corner Baseline Drive
pages.desc: Deny the reverse pass, Low-I traps with x4, x3 drops, x1 splits two and closes on the skip.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Dribble Penetration & Rotations

pages.title: Wing Middle Drive
pages.desc: Slide vertically and cut it off or force it to the top. If it's inevitable, the lowest weak-side player steps across.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Dribble Penetration & Rotations

pages.title: Drives with a Low or High Post Defender
pages.desc: The post defender traps from the 1/2 front, or denies the high post and doesn't help. Rotations shift behind them.

track.title: No Middle Man-to-Man: Dribble Penetration & Rotations

pages.title: Skip Pass Rotations
pages.desc: Banana-cut closeouts so there's no middle. Everyone sprints on the flight of the ball.

track.title: No Middle: Spartan Defensive System

pages.title: No Middle: Control the Middle-Third
pages.desc: Full court pressure, push dribblers to the sidelines, and the opposing PG can't dribble through the jump circle.

track.title: No Middle: Spartan Defensive System

pages.title: Elite Closeouts & Deny Lane Penetration
pages.desc: High active hands, choppy feet, attack the high hip. Get in his pocket, voice pressure, force to short corners.

track.title: No Middle: Spartan Defensive System

pages.title: Pack Gaps
pages.desc: Jump to ball, stunt and recover, 2 passes away = midline, melt to the ball on baseline penetration.

track.title: No Middle: Spartan Defensive System

pages.title: Ice Ball Screens
pages.desc: The on-ball defender makes the dribbler reject and go baseline, bigs drop, and we trap 1-2 steps outside the lane.

track.title: No Middle: Spartan Defensive System

pages.title: Rebound! & Get Turkeys
pages.desc: Ultimate physicality, two hands, 10 Spartan hands on every rebound. 3 consecutive stops = turkey, 7 per game.

track.title: Man-to-Man: Post, Transition, Inbounds & Pick and Roll

pages.title: Keeping the Ball Out of the Post
pages.desc: Beat them down the floor, great on-ball defense, push them off the block.

track.title: Man-to-Man: Post, Transition, Inbounds & Pick and Roll

pages.title: Post Denial: 3/4 Front and 1/2 Front
pages.desc: Above the free-throw line we 3/4 front. Below it we 1/2 front from the baseline side.

track.title: Man-to-Man: Post, Transition, Inbounds & Pick and Roll

pages.title: Transition Defense: Three Crash, Two Back
pages.desc: Never stand in no man's land. Two get back as a top defender and a bottom defender.

track.title: Man-to-Man: Post, Transition, Inbounds & Pick and Roll

pages.title: Trapping a Dominant Low Post Player
pages.desc: Low-I traps high side, x2 drops, x1 becomes the interceptor, ball-side stays in complete denial.

track.title: Man-to-Man: Post, Transition, Inbounds & Pick and Roll

pages.title: Defending BLOBs
pages.desc: Make them throw it to the top. Defender near the rim, switch everything, or flash a 2-3 zone.

track.title: Man-to-Man: Post, Transition, Inbounds & Pick and Roll

pages.title: Defending the Pick and Roll
pages.desc: Hedge and fight over, switch, or go under: know the choice and the cost.
